_comment: Tests that fail today, each one written down with an owner and a reason. REVIEWER-AUTHORED, hand-written on purpose: unlike axe-baseline.json, which is recorded from a scan, a failing test needs a sentence saying who owns it. The harness fails on any failure that is NOT in here, and fails just as loudly when an entry starts passing, so this file cannot quietly go stale. Delete an entry the moment its fix lands. Empty is the goal state.
